messages:
Alex: dropped a quick mock of the "regression timeline" in Figma — includes a scrubber, compact markers, and inline hover annotations. want quick UX/a11y nits before i freeze the spec.
Mai: nice! first pass: active marker contrast is too weak on light backgrounds. try #004BCF or add a 2px white halo.
Jordan: keyboard needs: left/right to move, home/end to jump, enter to open detail. visible focus ring mandatory. also aria-live region announcing "Diff X/Y: regression in <test-name>" when selection changes.
Sam: overlapping diffs look messy. propose cluster pill (e.g. "+2") that expands a mini-list on click. preserve individual hover to show quick snippet.
Anita: copy tweak: main button currently "Show changes" — feels generic. suggestion: "Open regression details" or "View diff report". resolved state should be "No regression detected" not "Clean".
Alex: clustering + heatmap idea: use density shading for quick scan and count pills where dense. drilldown shows list with tiny icons for severity.
Mai: color accessibility: red/orange/green badges must hit 3:1 on white or include an icon/text fallback. also avoid relying on color alone.
Jordan: for screen readers add aria-label on timeline: "Diff timeline. Use arrow keys to navigate. Press Enter to open details." set focus to first control in the opened panel and trap focus while open.
Sam: mobile: make scrubber touch target >=44px and allow swipe horizontally. truncate long test names with ellipsis, show full name in a tap overlay.
Anita: microcopy: tooltip language should be consistent — use "Regression: <short-reason>" not mixed verbs. also unify severity terms (Minor/Moderate/Critical).
EvalBot: automated: eval run 1821 attached. summary: 9 diffs, 2 regressions. PR #419 will plug timeline events into backend.
Alex: engineering note: considering role="slider" for keyboard accessibility + aria-valuetext to expose "diff 3 of 9: <test>". any objections?
Jordan: slider is fine but ensure correct semantics for screen readers; double-check with VoiceOver. also add a live region update when a diff is resolved automatically.
Mai: animation suggestions: 120ms fade on hover tooltips, avoid motion for reduced-motion preference. focus ring should be 3px and visible in high-contrast mode.
Sam: scorecard integration: add a small deep link "Open in scorecard" that anchors to the diff and highlights the relevant eval row for reviewers to approve.
Anita: tiny UX nudge: let users toggle timeline density (compact / expanded) in settings. default = compact for busy runs.
Alex: thanks — i'll update figma + spec with accessible color tokens, aria snippets, compact/expanded variants, and the cluster pill behavior. will post PR and ping for quick review. :rocket:
